name: Beatrice
source:
A tall woman with the lower body of a snake. She has a short temper and is very prideful due to her rich upbringing. Her claws are extremely sharp which she uses to hunt wild animals for fun. She thinks of [url=https://vndb.org/c69867]Morgan[/url] as being very stupid upon meeting him.

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/812410/]Steam[/url]]
